steps.name: Strange Woman
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Strange Woman
steps.text: This way... no, that way? What did that say again...

steps.name: Strange Woman
steps.text: Should be this way. There's the polluted area.

steps.name: Strange Woman
steps.text: Let me double-check to be sure...

steps.name: Strange Woman
steps.text: Hey, wait for me!

steps.name: Strange Woman
steps.text: Oh, what a coincidence, you were headed the right way.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Like I said, you're needed later, not right now.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: But I'm starting to doubt your abilities as a Catastrophe Messenger.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: What? Don't talk about things you know nothing about.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: The job of a Catastrophe Messenger carries a huge responsibility. Many lives hinge upon being able to accurately determine the movement of a Catastrophe. It's better to be safe than sorry.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Why do you think there are so few of us? You're lucky to have even met me. It's not like you've met any others before, right?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: ...Cut the crap.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Admit it. You need my help to enter the post-Catastrophe area.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I admit it.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Can we continue now?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: So, who's this guy who Cowell kidnapped and took into the disaster zone, what is he to you?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: (Inhale)

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Hey, don't be so quick to clam up. You know I'm looking for Cowell because I have a debt to settle with him. It'd be a problem if the one you're looking for is actually on his side.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: You brought down a whole regiment of Cowell Mining guards, practically laughing while sitting in the electric chair. You're not someone I want to mess with.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: So I need to know who he is. We're working together, aren't we?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: ...He's my employer.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Employer? Are you his bodyguard?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: We were employed by Maize Drill Inc., Cowell Mining's competitor. You may have heard of the name.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: The first company to send a survey team into this disaster zone, right?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: They entered from the southeast, quickly securing the ore deposit for Maize Drill.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: We were employed by that survey team. The veins they discovered were just the tip of the iceberg. There are indications of more exposed veins at the former site of the central plaza.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The company was going to perform a second survey, this time entering from the north, and had set up a temporary camp on the edge.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I went into town yesterday morning for a shopping trip... edamame... and when I returned, the camp was in ruins, and there was no one to be found.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I tracked my employer's signal to the camp you were at, but found only the tracking device.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: And you know the rest.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Well, I admire your professionalism, but I must remind you that Cowell is leading this band personally. Lots of heads are gonna roll on this trip, and your employer's is probably one of them.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: This is Rim Billiton. No need for you to get involved.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: My contract remains valid until my employer's death is confirmed.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I do the job I'm paid to.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Suit yourself.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: There might be another polluted area ahead. Let me check... hey, wait up.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: You walk fast.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Stop complaining, Le—

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Le-what?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: ...Nothing.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: I'm beginning to suspect that you're hiding something from me.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I'm hiding a lot of things from you.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: ...I guess, but there's one thing in particular that's concerning me.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: You lost contact with your employer, right?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Then how do you know the way?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Multiple times, you've moved before I said anything, but it always ends up being the right direction.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: How are you doing it?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Does it matter?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Could it be that you're with Cowell...?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Look here.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: At what?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: On the ground.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Originium dust, sand, ash... the same mix you see everywhere after a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: That grey stuff is sand, not ash.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Tiny particles of eroded limestone that would ordinarily blend into yellow sand.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: That's pretty specialized knowledge... but what does it mean?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: ...It's normally mixed in, but now it's on the surface by itself.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Someone made it happen. On purpose.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Separating different types of sand is a special trick of my employer's. He left this as a mark, one that the enemy is unlikely to notice.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: So you were secretly following it as a trail this whole time.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Here, there... there's a lot of it.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Sounds like your employer's a pretty smart guy.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: 'Tch'?!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Just a guy who's bad with money... a real jerk.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Sounds like you guys are pretty close.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: As close as it takes to punch him in the face.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: If that's the case, why would someone like you be working for him? Extortion? Blackmail?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: He's my first employer. Changing jobs would be a pain.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Have you ever thought about doing something else? Is there anything you wish you could?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No idea.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: What did you use to do?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I... I'd never left home before I started working for Leon.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Let's just say—purely hypothetically—that you're on good terms with your employer, and he's dead when you find him...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Now you're no longer bound by your contract. Would you do anything... outside the scope of it?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No. What are you implying?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Well, there's a lot you could do with your skills. Say... taking revenge for him.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: That would be meaningless.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Simple. Anyone who could kill my employer is someone I couldn't deal with on my own. It would be suicide.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The logical thing would be to turn around and leave. The bodyguard contract has expired.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Regardless of whether I was at fault, there's still no reason to stay and make the situation worse.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Even if I had a mind to take revenge, I wouldn't just rush in hot-hotheadedly. I would make a plan, wait for the right opportunity.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Only fools let revenge occupy their minds.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Enough delay. We need to catch up.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Over there!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Get down!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Quick! Put on your mask!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Looking at the particle distribution patterns, this wasn't caused by aftershocks. It's...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The disintegration of Infected.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: There must be many Infected bodies nearby. But why? Did the Catastrophe Messenger in charge of this area not give any evacuation notice?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Unlikely. The situation in the east indicates that there was plenty of advance warning. There should have been enough time to give notice and evacuate.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: How could this have happened? Was the Catastrophe Messenger new to the job?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: There's another possibility...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Maybe they did give warning in time... but someone intentionally prevented the notice from reaching the population.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: By the time anyone realized, it was too late.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Delay the Catastrophe warnings? Why would anyone do that?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: This is Rim Billiton. The mining companies run the show.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Catastrophes reveal ore veins, so every time one happens it results in a scramble by the companies to claim the new ones.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Sometimes, this takes the form of delaying the communication of evacuation notices... if you're unscrupulous enough.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Bastards...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Cowell planned this well, but he didn't count on your survey team moving even quicker than he did.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: You must have a good Catastrophe Messenger on your side. Anyway, it threw a wrench into his plans.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: I guess that piece of fowlbeast dung has turned to kidnapping now.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Leon...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Like I said, you shouldn't be too optimistic about your employer's prospects in Cowell's hands.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: We keep going.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Didn't find anything.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You searched the entire area?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: I scanned every inch, but nothing. No new markings.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: ...You're right, the trail ends here.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The prospective mining area was in the south. If that's their target...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Compass doesn't work here.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: We'll expand the search radius. You said there were signs of an approaching sandstorm. How far away is it?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: 20 minutes, tops.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Oh, right! I think I caught a glimpse of a cave behind that hill.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Could be man-made. There might be enemies.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Lead the way.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: It's dark...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Do you smell that? Seems like blood.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Keep going.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: ...Didn't think you'd need someone to scout the way for you. And to think I worked so hard to help you avoid polluted areas and secondary disaster zones.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You were the one who insisted on coming with me.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Fine, fine...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Get back!
Ayerscarpe? It's me!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You're... Cruise Jr.? From the survey team?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Thank goodness you remember me.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Just you here? Where are the others?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: ...Let me take a look at your arm.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Blunt trauma and some deep cuts... properly treated, though. You'll be fine.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: This bandaging... did Leonhardt do this?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Injuring an arm. Cowell's favorite punishment. Can't do anything in Rim Billiton without a good pair of hands.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Where are the others? Where's Leonhardt? Is he with the rest of them?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I'm the only one here. Leonhardt saved my life...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: What did he say to you?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: He told me to wait here for you... before he died...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: What did you say? He died?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I know it's hard to accept... but no one could have survived that explosion.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Explosion... Tell me everything. I need to know what happened to him.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Every last detail.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Ayerscarpe...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Hey, don't give him such a scary look. He just had a brush with death. Cut him some slack.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Leonhardt told me to give you this.
His gaze moves slowly to the bundle of clothing.
The clothes he had seen so many times before look so unfamiliar now. Just looking at the blood stains makes his eyes hurt.
Leonhardt always kept his clothes sparkling clean, not a speck of dust on them. Annoyingly so.
How could this have happened?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: He also asked me to pass on a message...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: 'Stay away, Ayers.'

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I couldn't hear the next part very clearly, but I think he said...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: 'I'm terminating your contract.'
The words were like a needle piercing his ear. His hand trembles as he receives the clothes.
There is a lump in his throat that he cannot swallow.
In the end, all he does is take a deep breath.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Ayerscarpe...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Your employer... your friend. Was he a Catastrophe Messenger?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: A decent one. It's a shame, but it is what it is.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: It's okay. I guess I'm no longer contracted.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I'll get some rest, then head back the way we came.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Why are you just staring at me? Sit down.
He leans against the rock wall and slides down, setting the clothes aside.
Then he feels something heavy inside the clothes.
He reaches into the pocket.
There is a box of edamame inside.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Hey! Where are you going?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Are you crazy? There's a sandstorm outside!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: That's nothing! Leon... he wouldn't die so easily!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: And even if he's dead, I'll...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Calm down!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: You need to keep a cool head! You won't achieve anything if you don't take stock of the situation.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Trust me, no one wants a piece of Cowell more than I do.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: We've come so far! There are only so many places he can run, this deep into the disaster zone.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Be patient. We're so close.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: At least wait for the sandstorm to subside.
15 minutes later.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: The mine exploded as soon as I got out, throwing me off my feet.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I got up and ran without looking back, all the way here.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Just to double-check, towards the south, along that crag, right?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Yeah, that's the way I came.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: The sandstorm has mostly subsided.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: You could stay here, Ayerscarpe, if you need some time to collect your thoughts...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: The mine entrance is blocked. We can't get in on our own.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Tire tracks. They were here.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Not sure if they're leading into or away from the mine. And we can't tell what's inside from here.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Those rocks wouldn't trap him. He could destroy them easily.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: But it's sealed shut, and there was an explosion...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: If he's still alive, he would have followed them, trying to rescue the others.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: If they're looking for new veins... there's only one way to find them. Inside.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: But the area ahead is heavily polluted, with high risk of a secondary disaster. Going in by ourselves is a big risk.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: They'll have to come back this way eventually, even with proper protection. We can wait here and ambush Cowell.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: We keep going.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Can't you just accept the truth already?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: What truth? I still haven't seen him with my own eyes.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Your turn. Leon can move through polluted areas unhindered. I'm sure you can manage too, being a Catastrophe Messenger yourself.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: I... I'll do what I can.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Wind and sand everywhere. I can't see anything.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Maybe... perhaps... according to my observations...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Shut it!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Infected creature! Behind you!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: This is a bad place to fight.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: There's a house over there! We can take shelter.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Whew... like I said, this is too much for the two of us.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Here comes the sandstorm again.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You're not a Catastrophe Messenger, are you?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger?
steps.text: No, I'm not.

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger?
steps.text: I knew the facade wouldn't hold up ever since you mentioned that your employer was a real one. I'm actually surprised it took you so long to call me out on it.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Who are you then?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger?
steps.text: I'm Tamika. I'm a bodyguard, like you.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Do you still want to travel with me?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Doesn't matter to me.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: We could both die here, though. I wouldn't get my revenge, and you wouldn't save your friend.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: But like I said, you could stay, and I'll keep going. Could be one less corpse in our future.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Why can't you accept that your friend is dead? Is it worth giving up your life just to see for yourself?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Do you remember what I told you about the Catastrophe warning? The one that was covered up?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: The Catastrophe Messenger who sent the warning was my best friend... I was the one who got her the job.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Did you learn about Catastrophes from her?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Yeah. My protective gear belonged to her too.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Then how... Did Cowell kill a Catastrophe Messenger?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Cowell Mining blocked off communications when signs of Catastrophe appeared. The residents never got the warning.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: She rushed back when she learned about it. The Catastrophe was very near by then, but she headed straight into the red zone to help with the evacuation.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: I was one step too late, just in time to see a cloud of Originium dust swallow her whole...

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Just thinking of what she saw in her last moments made my blood boil. I wanted to tear Cowell limb from limb with my bare hands.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Until I met you, someone else who'd lost someone important... Then I understood.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: To be honest, I wanted to use you to get rid of Cowell. But I have to admit, you were right.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Revenge isn't worth it.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: You're strong enough to survive here. There are many things you can do in place of your friend.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Not like me. I've come too far to turn back... Leave the rest to me.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You're overthinking it.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I would've come here, with or without you. I came because there's something I wanted to see.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I'm doing what I'm doing... because Leon isn't dead.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: My employer isn't dead, so I still have a job to do, as a bodyguard.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: How can you be so sure?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Leon is a jerk. Talks too much, gets into trouble. Gets me into trouble.

spans.text: Leon is a jerk. Talks too much, gets into trouble. Gets

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: But he knows how to survive, better than anyone. I've lost count of the times we've worked together to get out of a tight spot.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: He's the reason I'm having this conversation with you, rather than turning into a dried-out husk in the barrenlands.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I know him. Those words didn't sound like something he'd say. I need to see with my own eyes.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: And... he promised me something he still hasn't done. I won't let him off the hook that easily.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Fine, assuming your friend's not dead, how are we gonna find him? Is he just gonna drop from the sky?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No, what you said made me remember...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Leon always drawled on about the properties of Catastrophes.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Tch. So many things floated to the surface when I heard he was dead.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Including these.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You just wait, Leon.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: T-That's nuts!

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Is that how you and your friend have been avoiding danger in Catastrophe zones?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: It was Leon's idea. I had to make do with what's available. Is there a problem?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: That's just climbing out the fire and into the frying pan... or is it the other way round? Whatever, doesn't matter. No wonder you were able to penetrate the disaster zone so quickly.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Tire tracks... they've been here alright.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Someone's coming!

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Cowell's muscles. Much tougher than the ones in the camp. Even you...

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: We'll need a plan, find a weak spot... Ayerscarpe?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Ayerscarpe?!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Help!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: R-Run away!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: No—

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I'm back. You said something?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: ...They're all down?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I think so.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I'm comfortable on the attack. Is there a problem?

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: ...You've got to be kidding me.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Did you find you friend?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: If he's really dead... maybe I'll become a Catastrophe Messenger.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Wait, there's another room over there.

steps.name: Cowell
steps.text: Who are you? Guards! Intruders!

steps.name: Cowell
steps.text: Guards!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Cowell
steps.text: What do you want? I'm the owner of Cowell Mining! I own these mines! Is it money that you want? I can pay you!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Enough. Just answer my question.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Where's the Catastrophe Messenger you kidnapped?

steps.name: Cowell
steps.text: He... he's inside the mines.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Still alive?

steps.name: Cowell
steps.text: A-Alive! Absolutely alive! He was the one who led us here!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: He's all yours.

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Do you remember me, Cowell?

steps.name: Cowell
steps.text: T-Tamika? Is that you? P-Protect me! I'll pay you whatever you want!

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: I stopped working for you the day you killed Claire. This one's for her...

steps.name: Tamika
steps.text: Claire...

steps.name: Cowell
steps.text: N-No! Stay back!
He did not turn back. Into the mines he went, one step at a time.
His steps were anxious at first, but began to slow down as the sound from the walls became clearer.
At last, they are calm, steady.
Like going to meet an old friend.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I-I'm sure we can talk this out! No hasty moves, okay? Please!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Oh, it feels so good to run freely into the sunset.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: All these Rim Billiton corporations are the same. I'm getting sick of them.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I want to take a break. For at least a month.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: And how will we eat without an income?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: ...You have savings, don't you?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Don't even think about it.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I guess it's time to think about looking for a regular salary.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Say, there's something I've been curious about.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So I told you I was dead, and that our contract was terminated, yet you still came for me.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: What would you have done if you'd arrived and found out I was really dead?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, say something.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Don't tell me I don't mean anything to you? I mean, I've kept my promise, traveled the world with you... Traveling for work still counts, right?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I mean, it was just a few coins... okay, maybe more than a few... but you're not holding any grudges over it, are you?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Say something!
